commands.notes: Watch uses the same single play/pause control shape as the iPhone playback surface; phone/tablet executes the toggle and returns a refreshed compact snapshot.
Watch sends a play intent to the canonical phone/tablet runtime and expects a refreshed compact snapshot response.
Watch sends a pause intent to the canonical phone/tablet runtime and expects a refreshed compact snapshot response.
Watch sends a forward navigation intent to the canonical phone/tablet runtime and expects a refreshed compact snapshot response.
Watch sends a backward navigation intent to the canonical phone/tablet runtime and expects a refreshed compact snapshot response.
Watch sends the selected resolved chapter id to the canonical phone/tablet runtime and expects a refreshed compact snapshot response.
Watch sends a delegated recording start intent; phone/tablet owns microphone, anchoring, persistence, and the refreshed compact snapshot.
Watch sends a delegated recording finish intent; phone/tablet saves the anchored interjection and returns the refreshed compact snapshot.
Watch exposes the iPhone summary sparkles action as a delegated AI intent; phone/tablet owns summary eligibility, provider calls, persistence, and pending job state.
Watch exposes the iPhone Discuss action as a delegated follow-up intent; phone/tablet owns prompt context, provider calls, persistence, and pending job state.

backendRequests.title: Publish state-aware available commands for compact Watch UI
backendRequests.details: CompactControlSnapshot now publishes availableCommands from state-aware compact exposed commands after command dispatch and snapshot reads.

backendRequests.title: Replay watch-tethered traces through compact dispatcher
backendRequests.details: Trace replay runs watch-tethered with a canonical phone-tablet-online runtime plus CompactControlDispatcher, similar to lock-screen-widget.

backendRequests.title: Clarify delegated interjection recording lifecycle
backendRequests.details: Gate 3 trace replay verifies beginInterjection reports recording_interjection and finishInterjection returns to item_playback through the canonical phone/tablet runtime.

backendRequests.title: Decide Watch chapter skip semantics
backendRequests.details: Compact dispatch now passes skip units through and SessionEngine supports chapter-unit skip behavior for text items with Listening Maps.

backendRequests.title: Publish compact timeline rows for Watch
backendRequests.details: CompactControlSnapshot now includes source chapters and generated AI/summary rows so the Watch can show timeline context below the primary controls.

notes: Gate 3 does not own playback, recording, AI provider calls, persistence, transcription, or sync locally.
Gate 3 must not require Xcode project edits until the steward creates a Watch target scaffold.
The Watch playback interface should mirror the iPhone playback surface: brief chapter or generated-turn label, skip back, play/pause, skip forward, interject, AI summary, and Discuss.

The Watch compact snapshot should contain current item, target, chapter, playback status, progress, recording state, pending AI job state, last user turn type, and availableCommands; it must not require the current source excerpt.
traces/watch-chapter-navigation.json covers play/pause, chapter jump, chapter skip, boundary idempotence, delegated interjection, AI summary, and Discuss.
